sources.title: MiniMax M2.7
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: MiniMax's official M2.7 announcement extends the M2 line toward complex agent harness construction, Agent Teams, skills and dynamic tool search, and describes the model as participating in aspects of its own development workflow.

limitations.text: The bound news source does not itself establish every requested open-weight serving integration or exact license term; those were observed in a separate official model card during Discovery but are outside this one-source Evidence task.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify MiniMax M2.7 Agent Teams, skills/tool-search claims, model-assisted development positioning, open-weight distribution, serving support, and license from official sources.
targets.finding: The official announcement verifies Agent Teams, skills/tool search and model-assisted-development positioning; open-weight serving and license details are not promoted from a different source into this single-source card.
